Experience the Mesmerizing melody Manasu Maree from the movie "V", featuring Nani, Sudheer Babu, Nivetha Thomas, and Aditi Rao Hydari. Composed by Amit Trivedi, this enchanting track captures the essence of love and emotion beautifully.
Song - Manasu Maree
Music - Amit Trivedi
Lyrics – garu
Singers – Amit Trivedi, Shashaa Tirupati & Yazin Nizar
Movie Name - V
Cast - Nani, Sudheer Babu, Nivetha Thomas and Aditi Rao Hydari.
Director - Mohana krishna Indraganti
